verdict.rationale: Numeral ships an MCP server that lets external AI agents query raw account data (nexus status, filings, transactions) — e.g. 'which states have I triggered nexus' — but this is infrastructure for connecting third-party/generic AI agents, not a first-party built-in tax-Q&A assistant that answers 'is this taxable' or 'why did this invoice tax this way' from its own rule base with citations. No evidence of a native chatbot or rule-cited answer engine exists in the pack.
